changelog:
Solana Funding Rate Arbitrage v2.0 introduces major new features:

- Added full auto-trading with automated position management and order execution.
- Multi-DEX support: now operates on both Drift Protocol (live trading) and Flash Trade (dry run).
- Integrated risk management, including stop-loss, max drawdown, and auto-rebalancing.
- New position manager tracks PnL and funding collected.
- Scheduled funding rate scans enabled via cron integration.
- Expanded documentation, strategy options, and configuration samples.
